name: Beta 1.0.48
notes: Specialist crews: a planet's 2nd and 3rd teams now pick a role (Drillers, Haulers, Dockhands or Prospectors, one of each per planet), are chosen from three named candidates with quirks, and unlock a choice of veteran perks at 10 and 20 upgrades. Dockhands cut docking and loading time and add silo space; Prospectors raise ore yield, strike rich veins and steer probes. Existing second and third teams become Drillers or Haulers with spare points refunded. Economy retuned so pacing stays the same
